title: From an answer (A), keyed false: the answer's layer (Background) has no keys this lesson can work on. One sentence says so, then what the answer's step still lets them do on their own, and it stops: no demonstration, no proposal. T081: the snapshot starts no lesson (`lesson: null`), so there is nothing to record or end

steps.text: Select Background's keys and choose Easy Ease (F9).
Play it back and watch the Background.

note: Spec 014 T079. Needs a capture with the layer list (the practice capture with read R2 has it); older captures read a layer that has no keys as 'lost'. Background has no keys in it. T081 (435c810): a hand-in on a layer with no keys now returns `lesson: null` with the hand-in slice and nothing the lesson would use, so no lesson is open: the case pins `lesson: null`, no record_lesson, no demonstration, and no check. An end_lesson isn't required (it would only get LESSON_NOT_OPEN).
